*1 Can communicate with devices that output data using the Change Of State (send data when any change occurs) method. If 505 bytes or more are used, the device used must support Large Forward Open (optional CIP specification). *4 The KV-NC1EP has an IGMP client function, so unnecessary multicast packets can be filtered by using an Ethernet switch that supports IGMP Snooping. *5 In cases where the KV-NC1EP is connected via cyclic communication multicasting from the originator, there may be more than 64 connections. Even in such cases, the operation of the KV-NC1EP will be guaranteed only up to 64 connections. *6 Up to 64 total connections can be used with the Cyclic Communication function. Even when the total number of connections exceeds 64, the operation of the KV-NC1EP will be guaranteed only up to 64 connections.
